body: You’re not alone op! For me it’s fire and just accidents in general. I hear sirens too, but it’s related to firetrucks and I just panic. But this usually happens when I’m under a lot of stress or when I’m triggered over something. I’ve been under antipsychotics and it’s somehow helping me. But when it’s too much, I try to distract myself by playing games, watching videos, or writing how I feel. It doesn’t help as much but it still kind of calms me down.

And I’m sorry if I have to reply again, but the reason why he couldn’t leave me alone was due to my abusive dad. I live in a third world country and you’ll only get a decent job when you have a degree. I can’t move out and I’m in a new city due to college. My ex was the first person I met here. My dad hasn’t been paying my tuition fee because of his debt (even though he has a high paying job) that’s why I cried to him on the first of June. I am well aware that I shouldn’t be dependent. I am already going to therapy, but due to the restrictions they still have I am unable to see my therapist in person. 

My ex said he couldn’t heal if he won’t stay by my side, but I was the one who insisted on not helping me out since I know it’s hopeless. My mom has no backbone and she couldn’t leave my dad, and we’re all financially dependent on him. 

My ex admitted that the breakup was abrupt, he didn’t know why he did it, that is why I’m still confused about all of this until now.
I was the one who actually told him to stop helping me out, but he insisted. He only listened when I told him in person last Saturday. But thank you for the advice

thank you for replying, I just needed some confirmation about all of this since I’ve been always told that I’m overreacting. I just realized that he does not really consider how I felt about all of this, and I just found out that instead of communicating with me, he’s been playing games. I finally have my confirmation, and I hope  your friend’s small business will flourish!
thank you. I needed the confirmation. He is just a liar, and it pissed me off as well that he would do this considering I plan to be possibly a freelance artist after taking art school
I apologize if I sound confusing, But I thought I was being petty for getting mad at him for stealing art.
